title: Everyone Adores You (at least I do)
track: Everyone Adores You (at least I do)
lyrics:
[00:28.82]You can act all shy
[00:31.82]But you know that I want you
[00:41.81]In the dead of night
[00:45.14]I want to live with you
[00:51.92]So terrified of the road that takes you
[01:01.62]Me too
[01:04.89]Don't modify, everyone adores you
[01:14.23]At least I do
[01:34.25]Right where the blackbird sighs I look at you
[01:40.66]Through and through
[01:47.23]Right where your father died
[01:49.88]I hold on to your hand
[01:56.86]So terrified of the road that takes you
[02:06.69]Me too
[02:10.00]Don't modify, everyone adores you
[02:19.28]At least I do
[02:23.05]Everybody has you up on their wall sometimes
[02:29.62]Everybody thinks of you when they sleep at night
[02:36.03]When I say everybody I'm actually referring to me
